candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) in the inventory service, causing 503 on /v1/reservations, which propagates as ReadTimeout transport errors through order to gateway /v1/checkout returning 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs admitted; root cause of the Redis timeouts (saturation, network, config) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, cascading to 503 reservations, ReadTimeout on order calls, and 502 checkout responses. Gateway metrics confirm 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis-side telemetry to confirm the timeout origin
